versions.content: {DRAFT} ingressPort definition for SwitchStreamIden- tification If a SwitchStreamIdentification references one or more Cou- plingPort s in the role ingressPort , then a frame is considered matching for this ingress check if that frame is received over any of the referenced CouplingPort s in the role ingressPort . If a SwitchStreamIdentification references no CouplingPort s in the role ingressPort , then a frame is considered matching for this ingress check regardless over which CouplingPort that frame has been received.
